feature_queries.name: post_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.PostId,
  e.timestamp,
  p.OwnerUserId,
  DATE_DIFF('hour', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) AS post_age_hours,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.Title,'')) AS title_len,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.Body,'')) AS body_len,
  (LENGTH(COALESCE(p.Tags,'')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.Tags,''), '<', ''))) AS tag_count
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.Id = e.PostId

feature_queries.name: post_vote_windows
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.PostId,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS votes_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_1d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN votes v
  ON v.PostId = e.PostId
 AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: post_comment_windows
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.PostId,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS comments_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_1d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN comments c
  ON c.PostId = e.PostId
 AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: post_recent_vote_rate
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.PostId,
  e.timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', GREATEST(MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'), e.timestamp), 0)
    AS votes_per_day_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', GREATEST(MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'), e.timestamp), 0)
    AS votes_per_day_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.Id=e.PostId
LEFT JOIN votes v
  ON v.PostId=e.PostId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: log_and_sentiment
feature_queries.sql:
WITH vw AS (
  SELECT
    e.PostId,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(*) AS votes_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS v90
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN votes v
    ON v.PostId=e.PostId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
), cw AS (
  SELECT
    e.PostId,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(*) AS c_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c30
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN comments c
    ON c.PostId=e.PostId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  vw.PostId,
  vw.timestamp,
  LN(vw.votes_before + 1.0) AS ln_votes_before,
  LN(vw.v1 + 1.0) AS ln_votes_1d,
  LN(vw.v7 + 1.0) AS ln_votes_7d,
  LN(vw.v30 + 1.0) AS ln_votes_30d,
  LN(vw.v90 + 1.0) AS ln_votes_90d,
  (vw.up_before - vw.down_before) AS up_minus_down_before,
  vw.up_before * 1.0 / (vw.votes_before + 1.0) AS up_frac_before,
  LN(cw.c_before + 1.0) AS ln_comments_before,
  LN(cw.c1 + 1.0) AS ln_comments_1d,
  LN(cw.c7 + 1.0) AS ln_comments_7d,
  LN(cw.c30 + 1.0) AS ln_comments_30d
FROM vw
JOIN cw USING(PostId, timestamp)

feature_queries.name: tag_priors_weighted_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH global AS (
  SELECT AVG(popularity) AS global_mean_pop FROM train_table
), post_tags AS (
  SELECT
    e.PostId,
    e.timestamp,
    LOWER(TRIM(t.tag)) AS tag
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.Id=e.PostId
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(
    STR_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.Tags,''), '><', ' '), '<', ''), '>')
  ) AS t(tag)
  ON TRUE
  WHERE t.tag IS NOT NULL AND t.tag <> ''
), train_posts AS (
  SELECT
    tt.timestamp,
    tt.popularity,
    tp.Tags
  FROM train_table tt
  JOIN posts tp ON tp.Id=tt.PostId
), train_tag_rows AS (
  SELECT
    tr.timestamp,
    tr.popularity,
    LOWER(TRIM(t.tag)) AS tag
  FROM train_posts tr
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(
    STR_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(tr.Tags,''), '><', ' '), '<', ''), '>')
  ) AS t(tag)
  ON TRUE
  WHERE t.tag IS NOT NULL AND t.tag <> ''
), priors AS (
  SELECT
    pt.PostId,
    pt.timestamp,
    pt.tag,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ttr.timestamp >= pt.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN ttr.popularity ELSE 0 END) AS tag_sum_pop_180d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ttr.timestamp >= pt.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tag_n_180d,
    SUM(ttr.popularity) AS tag_sum_pop_all,
    COUNT(*) AS tag_n_all
  FROM post_tags pt
  LEFT JOIN train_tag_rows ttr
    ON ttr.tag = pt.tag
   AND ttr.timestamp < pt.timestamp
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    p.PostId,
    p.timestamp,
    p.tag,
    p.tag_n_all,
    p.tag_n_180d,
    (p.tag_sum_pop_all + 30.0*g.global_mean_pop) / (p.tag_n_all + 30.0) AS smooth_all,
    (p.tag_sum_pop_180d + 30.0*g.global_mean_pop) / (p.tag_n_180d + 30.0) AS smooth_180d
  FROM priors p
  CROSS JOIN global g
)
SELECT
  PostId,
  timestamp,
  SUM(smooth_all * tag_n_all) / NULLIF(SUM(tag_n_all),0) AS tags_wavg_smooth_all,
  SUM(smooth_180d * tag_n_180d) / NULLIF(SUM(tag_n_180d),0) AS tags_wavg_smooth_180d,
  AVG(smooth_all) AS tags_avg_smooth_all,
  MAX(smooth_all) AS tags_max_smooth_all,
  SUM(tag_n_all) AS tags_support_sum_all,
  SUM(tag_n_180d) AS tags_support_sum_180d
FROM scored
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: user_activity_votes
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.PostId,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p2.Id) AS user_posts_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p2.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS user_posts_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v2.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS user_votes_on_own_posts_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.Id=e.PostId
LEFT JOIN posts p2
  ON p2.OwnerUserId=p.OwnerUserId AND p2.CreationDate < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN votes v2
  ON v2.PostId=p2.Id AND v2.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY 1,2
